page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 62.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 7.75 GB of RAM per core. The instance is configured with local NVMe SSD storage, though no public IPv4 addresses are bundled by default.

From a resource allocation perspective, this server offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring significant memory capacity without the overhead of additional compute cores. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. However, the lack of a GPU limits its utility for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads.

This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, including medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage also supports workloads requiring low-latency read and write operations.
